mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which leads to increased borrowing costs and reduced corporate investments, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters indicates a strengthening economy, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the periods following GDP growth, or if the correlation between GDP growth and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening labor market, which can lead to wage inflation and increased consumer spending, boosting corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or if the correlation between UNRATE decreases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% within a month signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and investor pessimism, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances, or if the correlation between INDPRO decreases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When the real estate starts (HOUST) increase by more than 5% in a quarter and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) remains stable, it indicates strong demand without significant inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 5% in 1 quarter AND CPIAUCSL stable
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or if the joint effect of HOUST increase and stable CPIAUCSL on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month, combined with a stable unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a strong labor market without significant inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 20-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or if the joint effect of PAYEMS increase and stable UNRATE on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month, combined with a stable consumer price index (CPIAUCSL), signals accommodative monetary policy without inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of the triggered instances, or if the joint effect of FEDFUNDS decrease and stable CPIAUCSL on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters, combined with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in the same period, signals robust economic growth and a tightening labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases over 2 quarters AND UNRATE decreases > 0.5%
regime_hint: robust economic growth with labor market tightening
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces negative 60-day returns in more than 40% of the triggered instances, or if the joint effect of GDPC1 increase and UNRATE decrease on positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
